title: Wildflower Way
description: Travel through colour from a country path to dense flowers, rocky hillsides, a lively clearing and an open ridge. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

identity.scope: Decoration reference route; not a final five-minute day
identity.visual_source: Original generated pixel-art plate with native animated scenery

rooms.name: The country flower path
rooms.lesson: Low hops follow the flowers. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The dense flower meadow
rooms.lesson: Bellflowers lift you above the flower drifts. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The flower-covered rocks
rooms.lesson: Climb through the rocky flower beds. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The pollinator clearing
rooms.lesson: Land softly on the separated garden stones. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The panoramic ridge
rooms.lesson: The last crossing overlooks the whole meadow. Pass while the thorn head is folded.
